method: Calculated from component status history and corrections. Overlapping problems count once. Downtime counts per minute: Major outage 1, Partially unavailable 1, Degraded performance 0.5, Under maintenance 0, Operational 0. Percentages round down to two decimals. Only time with history counts, from the later of period start, first history and your uptime start date, in the page timezone. The end and future time are excluded. These figures use reported status. Maintenance rows show planned or cancelled work; they alone do not mean downtime.
